durableFields.notes: Existing Character Sheet resource expenditure state owns Lay On Hands, use-count, Monk Focus, and Sorcery Point point-pool spend facts. Task 83 adds no duplicate resource expenditure field.
Existing source-exact ordinary and created Spell Slot state owns Font of Magic conversion deltas. Pact Slot distinction remains separate and is not collapsed into this task's projection.
Existing Long Rest use-state owns Uncanny Metabolism repeat-use gating. Short Rest preserves it; Long Rest clears it.
Existing battle combatant character resources own battle-time Sorcery Point spend used by the Metamagic bridge before settlement projects the delta back to Character Sheet state.

Route events project feature-resource handoff ownership, source-exact Spell Slot delta facts, rejection holes, and battle-runtime entry. They are not stored as a duplicate feature-resource state machine.

notes: Task 83 introduced no durable CharacterSheet, BattleState, or BattleCreatureState fields.
CharacterBattleSheetOwner remains the sheet point/use state owner.
CharacterBattleResourceProjectionOwner remains the boundary-delta and hole owner for feature and Spell Slot resource projection.
CharacterBattleRuntimeOwner remains the battle-time Metamagic and spell action state owner.
Ordinary, created, and Pact slot distinctions remain source-exact and are not collapsed into a single resource field.
